features.title: Enterprise-Grade WhatsApp Gateway Infrastructure
features.subtitle: Built for developers, fast-growing startups, and modern businesses: from instant OTP verification, multi-device pool rotation, to 5-layer anti-ban protection.
features.otpDesc: Dispatch and verify 4-8 digit OTP codes to customer WhatsApp numbers instantly without creating custom database tables. Ephemeral state is stored securely in-memory in Redis with a 5-minute TTL, 60s cooldown, and single-use auto-burn.
features.otpF1: Zero Database Setup — Just call our clean REST API
features.otpF2: Anti Brute-Force lockout after 5 consecutive failed attempts
features.otpF3: VIP Express Stream bypasses bulk broadcast queues
features.multiDeviceDesc: Connect multiple WhatsApp devices simultaneously under one tenant. The intelligent routing engine rotates outbound messages across healthy devices to eliminate single-number rate limits.
features.antiBanDesc: Emulate human behavior with native typing indicators (ChatPresence), dynamic spintax variations {hello|hi}, random jitter delays (3–15s), and adaptive warmup pacing.
features.metaDesc: Effortlessly migrate existing Meta Cloud API v18.0–v20.0 integrations without changing request schemas. Ready-to-use code snippets in cURL, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Go.
features.broadcastDesc: Queue and dispatch thousands of scheduled marketing messages via high-throughput Redis stream pipelines with live real-time delivery rate analytics.
features.teamDesc: Role-based access control (Owner, Seller, CS Agent). Assign chats across team members and maintain strict tenant data isolation effortlessly.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Clear answers regarding number safety, technical integration, and operational reliability.
faq.q1: Is my WhatsApp number safe from being banned?
faq.a1: Wahide is equipped with a 5-layer anti-ban protection suite including dynamic spintax, human typing simulation (ChatPresence), randomized 3–15s jitter delays, and automatic multi-device load balancing. As long as you adhere to reasonable broadcast rates and avoid illegal spam, your numbers are optimally protected.
faq.q2: How do I connect my WhatsApp number to Wahide?
faq.a2: The process is seamless and takes under 10 seconds. Simply open the Wahide dashboard, click Add Device, and scan the generated QR code using your WhatsApp mobile app (just like connecting WhatsApp Web).
faq.q3: Does Wahide support OTP and transactional alerts?
faq.a3: Yes, Wahide features dedicated high-priority queuing for instant OTP codes, payment notifications, and transactional receipts to ensure delivery within seconds.
faq.q4: Can I integrate Wahide into my website or custom software?
faq.a4: Absolutely! We provide complete REST APIs with ready-to-use code snippets in cURL, Node.js, Go, PHP, and Python, alongside HMAC SHA256 encrypted two-way webhooks.
faq.q5: How is Wahide different from Meta's Official WhatsApp Cloud API?
faq.a5: The official Cloud API charges per-conversation fees based on strict template approvals with cumbersome business verification. Wahide delivers full multi-device flexibility without expensive per-message fees, making it the ideal solution for SMBs and fast-growing startups.
